items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And I liked both of them. Both of them were good musicians.

ctx.x: Well, fraternal twins don't have to look alike.

They didn't look alike. They didn't talk alike. They didn't anything alike. In fact, I had my doubts that they was brothers. I mean, there was nothing to resemble them -- except that they were brothers. And I liked both of them. Both of them were good musicians. But I didn't see no twins, where they were twins.
But that's beside the point. Anyway, I had taken Ted...
